verses.text: Allah exalted Adam, Nuh, the family of Ibraheem and the family of Imran above all the worlds. (Imran a.s is the father of Maryam (or Mary) and the grandfather of Isa (or Jesus)) (Surah Al-eImran : Section 4)
Reminder about Nuh a.s and his warning to the people to worship one Allah. But the people denied him. (Surah Al-A’raf : Section 8)
As a result, Allah saved Nuh and those who were with him in the ark and drowned all those who denied Allah’s revelation. (Surah Al-A’raf : Section 8)
To the People of Ad, was sent their brother Hud a.s. The people of Ad were made successors after people of Nuh and were given tall and strong stature. (Surah Al-A’raf : Section 9)
Nuh (a.s) said to his people: “Does it offend you that I should live among you and preach to you the revelations of Allah. You should know that I have put my trust in Allah. (Surah Yunus : Section 8)
But the people disbelieved and Allah saved Nuh and his followers in the Ark. Allah made them successors in the earth and drowned those who rejected Allah’s revelations. (Surah Yunus : Section 8)
Nuh (a.s) was sent to his people to warn them clearly; not to worship anyone except Allah. Otherwise to fear the punishment of a painful Day. (Surah Hud : Section 3)

Nuh (a.s) explained that he is not asking for any wealth for this work. He further declared that he would not drive away any of those who believe. The unbelievers were only acting out of ignorance. (Surah Hud : Section 3)
The people said that Nuh had argued too much, and asked for the scourge to be sent upon them. (Surah Hud : Section 3)
Allah ordered Nuh (a.s) to build an ark under His Eyes and according to His revelation. (Surah Hud : Section 4)

Allah’s command came, and the water from Al-Tannur (underground water) started to flow. Allah said to Nuh: Take into the Ark a pair from every species, your family and the believers. The believers were only few. (Surah Hud : Section 4)
Nuh thus called out: “Embark on it. In the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage; surely my Rabb is Forgiving, Merciful”. (Surah Hud : Section 4)
As the ark floated, Nuh called out to his son to come on board, but he declined and was eventually drowned in the flood. (Surah Hud : Section 4)

Finally, Allah ordered the earth to swallow the water and sky to cease the rain. The ark landed on mount Al Judi and it was said: “Gone are the wrongdoing people!” (only Nuh and those in the ark remained alive). (Surah Hud : Section 4)
Nuh reasoned about his son, being of his family but that Allah did not save him. (Surah Hud : Section 4)
Allah said that his son was not of his family, for he was not of righteous conduct. So do not ask Me of what you have no knowledge. (Surah Hud : Section 4)
Nuh (a.s) prayed - “I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge and unless you forgive me and have mercy on me, I shall surely be lost”. (Surah Hud : Section 4)

Allah sent Nuh (a.s) to his people and he invited them to worship one Allah. The people said that Nuh was just a human like them, and they had not heard of such a thing from their forefathers. They called Nuh (a.s) a madman. (Surah Al-Mu’minun : Section 2)
Nuh (a.s) prayed to Allah for help. Allah revealed His will to Nuh (a.s) saying: “Build an ark under Our Eyes and Our inspiration”. (Surah Al-Mu’minun : Section 2)

Allah ordered Nuh to take on board a pair of every species and those people who followed him. As for the wrongdoers, they were doomed to be drowned in the floods. There are many signs in this story and surely Allah does test people. (Surah Al-Mu’minun : Section 2)
Reminder of the People of Nuh (a.s) who rejected their Rasool and said to him: “If you do not stop, we shall stone you to death”. (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 6)
Nuh (a.s) prayed: O my Rabb! My people have denied me. Decide the case between me and them openly. Deliver me and the believers who are with me.” (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 6)

So Allah delivered Nuh and his people on the ark, and drowned the rest of the people in the flood. Surely, in this story is a great lesson, but most people do not learn a lesson and become believers. (Surah Ash-Shu’ara : Section 6)

Nuh (a.s) lived amongst his people for 950 years. Then because of their wrongdoings the flood overtook them. Allah delivered Nuh (a.s) and those who were in the ark. And Allah made the ark a sign for the people of the worlds. (Surah Al-Ankabut : Section 2)
Reminder is made about Nuh (a.s), and how Allah delivered him and his people from the mighty distress. (Surah As-Saffat : Section 3)

Allah made his progeny to be the only survivors (after the floods) and Allah left his good name among the people of the worlds. Salutation to Nuh among the people of the worlds. (Surah As-Saffat : Section 3)
Nuh (a.s) (admonished his people for 950 years), but finally he prayed to his Rabb “Help me, I have been overcome!”. (Surah Al-Qamar :Section 1)

So Allah opened the gates of heaven with pouring rain, and caused the earth to burst with gushing springs. And Allah carried Nuh (a.s) in an Ark which drifted on under His Eyes (i.e Allah’s loving care and protection); a reward for Nuh who was denied by the unbelievers. (Surah Al-Qamar :Section 1)
Allah has set an example to the unbelievers in the wife of Nuh (a.s) and the wife of Lut (a.s). (Surah At-Tahreem : Section 2)

They were married to two of Allah’s righteous servants, but they betrayed them in their religion. In no way could their husbands protect them from Allah. Both of them were told: “Enter the fire, along with those who enter it”. (Surah At-Tahreem : Section 2)

Nuh (a.s) said: O my People! I am sent towards you as a plain Warner. Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me. If you will do so, Allah will forgive you your sins and give you respite for an appointed term.” (Surah Nuh : Section 1)

(Nuh called on his people for 950 years, and after exhausting all his efforts) he said: “O my Rabb! I have called my people night and day, but my plea has only added to their aversion”. (Surah Nuh : Section 1)
Finally Nuh (a.s) submitted: “O my Rabb! My people have disobeyed me, and followed those chiefs whose wealth and children have added to them nothing but loss”. (Surah Nuh : Section 2)
Because of their wrongdoings they were drowned in the great flood and made to enter the fire. (Surah Nuh : Section 2)

Nuh (a.s) had prayed, “O my Rabb! Do not leave a single unbeliever on the surface of the earth. For if you spare any of them, they will mislead your servants and beget none but wicked disbelievers. (Surah Nuh : Section 2)
